### network
config interface 'svc_aes67'
	option device 'br_aes67'
	option proto 'static'
	option ipaddr '10.40.0.1'
	option netmask '255.255.255.0'

config device 'eth1_40'
	option name 'eth1.40'
	option type '8021q'
	option vid '40'
	option ifname 'eth1'
	option mtu '1500'

config device 'br_aes67'
	option name 'br_aes67'
	option type 'bridge'
	option ports 'eth1.40'
	option mtu '1500'
	option igmp_snooping '1'
	option multicast_querier '1'

config interface 'svc_dante'
	option device 'br_dante'
	option proto 'static'
	option ipaddr '10.20.0.1'
	option netmask '255.255.255.0'

config device 'eth2_20'
	option name 'eth2.20'
	option type '8021q'
	option vid '20'
	option ifname 'eth2'
	option mtu '1500'

config device 'br_dante'
	option name 'br_dante'
	option type 'bridge'
	option ports 'eth2.20'
	option mtu '1500'
	option igmp_snooping '1'
	option multicast_querier '1'

config interface 'svc_mgmt'
	option device 'br_mgmt'
	option proto 'static'
	option ipaddr '192.168.10.1'
	option netmask '255.255.255.0'

config device 'br_mgmt'
	option name 'br_mgmt'
	option type 'bridge'
	option ports 'eth1'
	option mtu '1500'

config interface 'svc_st2110'
	option device 'br_st2110'
	option proto 'static'
	option ipaddr '10.30.0.1'
	option netmask '255.255.255.0'
	option mtu '9000'

config device 'eth3_30'
	option name 'eth3.30'
	option type '8021q'
	option vid '30'
	option ifname 'eth3'
	option mtu '9000'

config device 'eth1_30'
	option name 'eth1.30'
	option type '8021q'
	option vid '30'
	option ifname 'eth1'
	option mtu '9000'

config device 'br_st2110'
	option name 'br_st2110'
	option type 'bridge'
	option ports 'eth3.30 eth1.30'
	option mtu '9000'
	option igmp_snooping '1'
	option multicast_querier '1'

### firewall
config zone 'zone_aes67'
	option name 'aes67'
	option network 'svc_aes67'
	option input 'REJECT'
	option output 'ACCEPT'
	option forward 'REJECT'

config rule 'allow_dhcp_aes67'
	option name 'Allow-DHCP-aes67'
	option src 'aes67'
	option proto 'udp'
	option dest_port '67'
	option target 'ACCEPT'

config rule 'allow_dns_aes67'
	option name 'Allow-DNS-aes67'
	option src 'aes67'
	option proto 'tcp udp'
	option dest_port '53'
	option target 'ACCEPT'

config rule 'allow_ntp_aes67'
	option name 'Allow-NTP-aes67'
	option src 'aes67'
	option proto 'udp'
	option dest_port '123'
	option target 'ACCEPT'

config rule 'allow_syslog_aes67'
	option name 'Allow-SYSLOG-aes67'
	option src 'aes67'
	option proto 'tcp udp'
	option dest_port '514'
	option target 'ACCEPT'

config zone 'zone_dante'
	option name 'dante'
	option network 'svc_dante'
	option input 'REJECT'
	option output 'ACCEPT'
	option forward 'REJECT'

config rule 'allow_dhcp_dante'
	option name 'Allow-DHCP-dante'
	option src 'dante'
	option proto 'udp'
	option dest_port '67'
	option target 'ACCEPT'

config rule 'allow_dns_dante'
	option name 'Allow-DNS-dante'
	option src 'dante'
	option proto 'tcp udp'
	option dest_port '53'
	option target 'ACCEPT'

config rule 'allow_ntp_dante'
	option name 'Allow-NTP-dante'
	option src 'dante'
	option proto 'udp'
	option dest_port '123'
	option target 'ACCEPT'

config rule 'allow_syslog_dante'
	option name 'Allow-SYSLOG-dante'
	option src 'dante'
	option proto 'tcp udp'
	option dest_port '514'
	option target 'ACCEPT'

config zone 'zone_mgmt'
	option name 'mgmt'
	option network 'svc_mgmt'
	option input 'ACCEPT'
	option output 'ACCEPT'
	option forward 'REJECT'

config rule 'allow_dhcp_mgmt'
	option name 'Allow-DHCP-mgmt'
	option src 'mgmt'
	option proto 'udp'
	option dest_port '67'
	option target 'ACCEPT'

config rule 'allow_dns_mgmt'
	option name 'Allow-DNS-mgmt'
	option src 'mgmt'
	option proto 'tcp udp'
	option dest_port '53'
	option target 'ACCEPT'

config rule 'allow_ntp_mgmt'
	option name 'Allow-NTP-mgmt'
	option src 'mgmt'
	option proto 'udp'
	option dest_port '123'
	option target 'ACCEPT'

config zone 'zone_st2110'
	option name 'st2110'
	option network 'svc_st2110'
	option input 'REJECT'
	option output 'ACCEPT'
	option forward 'REJECT'

config rule 'allow_dhcp_st2110'
	option name 'Allow-DHCP-st2110'
	option src 'st2110'
	option proto 'udp'
	option dest_port '67'
	option target 'ACCEPT'

config rule 'allow_dns_st2110'
	option name 'Allow-DNS-st2110'
	option src 'st2110'
	option proto 'tcp udp'
	option dest_port '53'
	option target 'ACCEPT'

config rule 'allow_ntp_st2110'
	option name 'Allow-NTP-st2110'
	option src 'st2110'
	option proto 'udp'
	option dest_port '123'
	option target 'ACCEPT'

config rule 'allow_syslog_st2110'
	option name 'Allow-SYSLOG-st2110'
	option src 'st2110'
	option proto 'tcp udp'
	option dest_port '514'
	option target 'ACCEPT'

config forwarding 'dante_to_aes67'
	option src 'dante'
	option dest 'aes67'
	option enabled '1'

config forwarding 'guest_to_mgmt_off'
	option src 'guest'
	option dest 'mgmt'
	option enabled '0'

config forwarding 'mgmt_to_aes67'
	option src 'mgmt'
	option dest 'aes67'
	option enabled '1'

config forwarding 'mgmt_to_dante'
	option src 'mgmt'
	option dest 'dante'
	option enabled '1'

config forwarding 'mgmt_to_st2110'
	option src 'mgmt'
	option dest 'st2110'
	option enabled '1'

### dhcp
config dhcp 'svc_aes67'
	option interface 'svc_aes67'
	option start '101'
	option limit '154'
	option leasetime '12h'
	list dhcp_option '42,10.40.0.1'
	list interface_name 'svc_aes67'

config dhcp 'svc_dante'
	option interface 'svc_dante'
	option start '101'
	option limit '154'
	option leasetime '12h'
	list dhcp_option '42,10.20.0.1'
	list interface_name 'svc_dante'

config dhcp 'svc_mgmt'
	option interface 'svc_mgmt'
	option start '101'
	option limit '154'
	option leasetime '12h'
	list dhcp_option '42,192.168.10.1'
	list interface_name 'svc_mgmt'

config dhcp 'svc_st2110'
	option interface 'svc_st2110'
	option start '101'
	option limit '154'
	option leasetime '12h'
	list dhcp_option '42,10.30.0.1'
	list interface_name 'svc_st2110'

### rsyslog
config forwarder 'stageneth_remote'
	option source '*.*'
	option target 'logs.example.local'
	option port '1514'
	option protocol 'tcp'

config rsyslog 'syslog'
	option udp_input '1'
	option udp_input_port '514'
	option tcp_input '1'
	option tcp_input_port '514'

### umdns
config umdns 'umdns'
	option enabled '1'
	list network 'svc_aes67'
	list network 'svc_dante'
	list network 'svc_mgmt'
	list network 'svc_st2110'

### mdns_repeater
config mdns_repeater 'main'
	option enabled '1'
	list interface 'br_aes67'
	list interface 'br_dante'
	list interface 'br_mgmt'
	list interface 'br_st2110'

### rsyslog.conf collector block
template(name="stagenethRemoteFile" type="string" string="/var/log/remote/%HOSTNAME%.log")
if ($fromhost-ip != "127.0.0.1" and $fromhost-ip != "::1") then {
	action(type="omfile" dynaFile="stagenethRemoteFile")
	stop
}
